source.post_text:
Melissa Barrera reveals she is about to launch her production company.

(https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/melissa-barreras-big-year-from-broadway-to-hollywood/id79681317?i=1000780409156

replies.text: This a GREAT move.  I’m excited for her.  She’s really smart and I think she can tap into both US and the Latin market like others can’t.
replies.author: @JRGhaddar

replies.text: Anti-semitic voices are finding success with an audience of hateful leftists.  Maybe Hasan Piker will back her?
replies.author: @Scotty_Free

replies.text: Smart move launching her own shingle now, she can finally shape projects around the kinds of roles and stories that actually matter to her instead of waiting on others.
replies.author: decoy

decoy_rationale: Slightly essay-like phrasing that over-explains the benefit in a neatly balanced way rather than sounding offhand.
